entry.title: Skopje Aqueduct

groundCutout.basis: Narrow mapped arcade opening for coarse ground; bounded visualization contact correction, not a survey.

terrainReference.basis: Approximate base from the standard PMTiles centre sample; bounded arcade placement shares this reference.

entry.note: The single inspected picture confirms the single-tier stone arcade, radial brick arches, upper relief openings and narrow open conduit. Retained mapped350.7703m bent channel line and standard PMTiles named aqueduct POIs establish location and the north/northwest native+X frame. The narrow outline is the conduit, not the full2.2m piers. The retained385.8m source length includes reconstructed17.5149m end ramps. Standard PMTiles centre274.8112m is an approximate working base; surrounding field samples vary several metres and do not resolve each footing. A bounded2m contact corridor follows the mapped bends and source1m rise, blending back to raw field by8m. Viewer ground opening remains within the arcade. Exact present conservation repairs and footing precision are not certified. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
